format.description: written = written exam, talk = talk or oral exam, project = project, unknown = not known yet.

aids.description: Allowed aids, e.g. 'Calculator TI-30X', '1 A4 sheet'.

chapters.description: Optional parts of the subject (e.g. script chapters), in order. The learner switches a chapter off until the lecture has happened: its topics are then left out of quizzes, study, endless mode and the calendar.

schedule.description: Weekly timetable: lectures, tutorials, labs. Taken from the university timetable.

notes.description: What the topic covers, sources, typical pitfalls. Helps the AI ask good questions.

due.description: Next review date: the earliest due card of the topic once cards have their own dates.

chapter.description: Id of an entry of the subject's `chapters`.

questions.description: Cards: prepared questions for understanding, each with its own schedule (due cards are asked, new ones come in through settings.newCardsPerDay). The learner grades themselves or lets the AI grade later. Calculations and constructions belong in dojo drills. Without this field the topic gets one generic "explain it" card; an empty array means the topic is trained only in dojos.

enabled.description: false = not part of the learning yet. Default true. Set in the app on the subject page.

prompt.description: The question (Markdown with $…$ LaTeX; an ```automaton block is drawn as a state diagram). Tests understanding, not recall of wording.

answer.description: Key points of a good answer (Markdown, $…$ LaTeX and ```automaton blocks allowed), shown to the learner after answering and used for grading.

blocked.description: The learner blocked this card: it is never asked again and a sync does not bring it back. Set by the app only.

stats.description: How the learner does with this card. Written by the app; drives the priority in endless mode and in study rounds.

due.description: Next review of this card; missing for a new card. Written by the app (spaced repetition per card).

intervalDays.description: Interval that produced the card's 'due'. Written by the app.

since.description: Day the card was first answered; counts against settings.newCardsPerDay. Written by the app.

status.description: open = not started, done = worked on, checked = checked or graded.

url.description: Where the sheet is published, e.g. the Moodle page.

file.description: The sheet itself: a path relative to the pack folder (e.g. material/db/sheet-3.pdf) or an https link. Shown next to the editor in the app.

tasks.description: The sheet's tasks as text, so they can be solved in the app one by one. Usually extracted from the PDF by the AI.

from.description: First day this class takes place, if not the whole semester.

until.description: Last day this class takes place.

kind.description: material = material source (e.g. Moodle), script = script version, notes = own notes.

url.description: Where to look: a link (e.g. the Moodle course) or a path relative to the pack folder (e.g. material/db/ or notes/db/).

everyDays.description: Flag the check as stale after this many days.
